info.description:
LeadNest is an AI-powered CRM for small businesses. This API manages companies, employees, customers, sales deals, follow-up tasks, activity timelines, dashboard analytics and AI-assisted drafting.
All endpoints are prefixed with /api/v1. Authenticated endpoints require an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Every query is scoped to the caller's company.
info.title: LeadNest API

get.description: Returns activities of the authenticated user's company in reverse chronological order.
Returns an activity of the authenticated user's company.

post.description: Summarizes customer information and recent activity history. The output is a suggestion, not a verified record.
Generates a professional follow-up email draft from customer and deal information. The output is a suggestion and requires human review before sending.
Suggests customers and open deals that may need follow-up based on CRM data. Suggestions require human confirmation.

get.description: Returns the AI interaction metadata recorded for the authenticated user's company.

post.description: Verifies email and password, rejects inactive accounts, and returns an access token.
Revokes the refresh token associated with the authenticated user.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token.
Creates a new company together with its first administrator inside a single transaction.

get.description: Returns the company of the authenticated user.

patch.description: Allows administrators to update their company's name, email, phone, and website.

get.description: Returns a paginated, searchable and filterable list of customers for the authenticated user's company.

parameters.description: Search by name, email or phone
parameters.name: search

post.description: Creates a customer for the authenticated user's company.

get.description: Returns a customer of the authenticated user's company. Use the include parameter to also return the customer's deals and recent activities.

parameters.description: Comma separated related records to include: deals, activities
parameters.name: include

delete.description: Permanently removes a customer of the authenticated user's company, together with its deals, tasks and activities.

patch.description: Updates a customer of the authenticated user's company.

get.description: Returns the activity timeline of a customer in reverse chronological order.

post.description: Records an activity on a customer timeline. The authenticated user is recorded as the author.

get.description: Returns tenant-scoped dashboard metrics, deal pipeline, recent activities and upcoming tasks.
Returns the most recent activities of the authenticated user's company.
Returns deal counts and values grouped by status and currency. Amounts are never combined across currencies.
Returns pending tasks of the authenticated user's company ordered by due date.
Returns a paginated, filtered and sorted list of deals for the authenticated user's company.

parameters.description: Search by title or customer name
parameters.name: search

post.description: Creates a deal linked to a customer of the authenticated user's company.

get.description: Returns a deal of the authenticated user's company.

delete.description: Permanently removes a deal of the authenticated user's company.

patch.description: Updates a deal. Moving to won or lost records the closing timestamp.

get.description: Returns a paginated and filtered list of follow-up tasks for the authenticated user's company.

parameters.description: Due date lower bound (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: due_from

parameters.description: Due date upper bound (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: due_to

post.description: Creates a follow-up task assigned to a company employee.

get.description: Returns a task of the authenticated user's company.

delete.description: Permanently removes a task of the authenticated user's company.

patch.description: Updates a task. Completing a task sets its completed_at timestamp.

get.description: Returns all users belonging to the authenticated user's company. Administrators only.

post.description: Adds a new user to the authenticated user's company. Administrators only.

delete.description: Marks a user of the authenticated user's company as inactive. Administrators only.

patch.description: Updates a user of the authenticated user's company. Administrators only.

get.description: Verifies that the service can reach its database dependency.
